page.notes: The right-hand column is cut off at the edge of the scan; the text of the Persian and Egyptian entries is truncated on the right, and the marginal figures on the far right are only partly visible. Some letters in the Greek-free table are uncertain, notably the Olympiad and the "tos imperio" line. Right-hand column is italic and partly cut; left-hand dates and numbers are printed beside the table. Several words are cut at the edges and are uncertain.
